content: settings.json hook config: matcher matches tool name (PreToolUse/PostToolUse) or event-specific dimension (SessionStart matches source, SessionEnd matches reason, Notification matches notification_type, PreCompact matches trigger manual|auto). Omitted/"*"/"" matcher = fires on every occurrence, no need to enumerate values. timeout field in seconds, default 600s for command hooks, lowered to 30s for UserPromptSubmit and 10s for MessageDisplay. Hooks are synchronous/blocking by default; command hooks support "async": true (fire-and-forget background) and "asyncRewake": true (background + wake Claude on exit code 2). All matching hooks for one event run in parallel, not sequentially. Exit code 0 = success (stdout JSON parsed if present); exit code 2 = blocking error (stderr used as block reason); any other code = non-blocking error (shown but execution continues). PostToolUse/PostToolUseFailure/SessionEnd/Notification hooks cannot block (tool already ran / no decision control) -- safe categories for a pure logger.
